atoms.name: div
atoms.rule: a / b divides and rounds toward zero (-7 / 2 = -3); b = 0 gives NaN.
atoms.plain: a / b divides and rounds toward zero (-7 / 2 = -3); b = 0 gives NaN.
atoms.plain_zh: a / b 是向零取整的除法，b = 0 时结果为 NaN。

atoms.name: mod
atoms.rule: a % b is the remainder a - b * (a / b), with the sign of a (-7 % 2 = -1); b = 0 gives NaN.
atoms.plain: a % b is the remainder a - b * (a / b), with the sign of a (-7 % 2 = -1); b = 0 gives NaN.
atoms.plain_zh: a % b 是余数 a - b * (a / b)，符号与 a 相同，b = 0 时结果为 NaN。

atoms.name: neg
atoms.rule: - a is the negation of a.
atoms.plain: - a is the negation of a.
atoms.plain_zh: - a 是 a 的相反数。

atoms.name: reverse
atoms.rule: a @ reverses the decimal digits of |a| and keeps the sign of a (120 @ = 21, -123 @ = -321).
atoms.plain: a @ reverses the decimal digits of |a| and keeps the sign of a (120 @ = 21, -123 @ = -321).
atoms.plain_zh: a @ 把 |a| 的十进制数字倒过来写，再保留 a 的符号。

atoms.name: triangle
atoms.rule: # a is sign(a) * |a| * (|a| + 1) / 2, computed exactly; only its result is checked against the bound (# 4 = 10, # -4 = -10).
atoms.plain: # a is sign(a) * |a| * (|a| + 1) / 2, computed exactly; only its result is checked against the bound (# 4 = 10, # -4 = -10).
atoms.plain_zh: # a 是带符号三角数 sign(a) * |a| * (|a| + 1) / 2。

atoms.name: popcount
atoms.rule: a $ is the number of 1 bits in the binary form of |a| (7 $ = 3).
atoms.plain: a $ is the number of 1 bits in the binary form of |a| (7 $ = 3).
atoms.plain_zh: a $ 是 |a| 的二进制里 1 的个数。

atoms.name: digitsum
atoms.rule: & a is sign(a) times the sum of the decimal digits of |a| (& -123 = -6).
atoms.plain: & a is sign(a) times the sum of the decimal digits of |a| (& -123 = -6).
atoms.plain_zh: & a 是 |a| 的各位数字之和，再乘上 a 的符号。

domain.en: Values are hours 0 to 11; inputs and results are reduced modulo 12.
domain.zh: 取值是 0 到 11 的时刻，输入和结果都对 12 取模。

settings.en: The preset that selects these atoms and defaults.
settings.zh: 选择这些原子和默认设置的预设。

settings.en: Every integer input, literal, and result is reduced modulo this number.
settings.zh: 每个整数输入、常数和结果都对这个数取模。

settings.en: A recursive call reduces its counter modulo a number drawn from this range, so it unfolds fewer times than that number.
settings.zh: 递归计数先对这个范围里抽到的数取模，所以展开次数小于这个数。

settings.en: The range of numbers in generated expressions and branch thresholds.
settings.zh: 生成算式和分支阈值所用的数值范围。

why.en: These atoms are one example. Atoms are chosen by the user: any function with a rule can be registered and the same three composition forms grow operators from it.
why.zh: 这些原子只是一个例子。原子由用户自己选：任何写得出规则的函数都能注册，同样三种组合方式会从它长出新运算符。

operators.name: ♦₁
operators.plain: Take the signed triangle number of b, then subtract the signed triangle number of a from it.
operators.plain_zh: 先求 b 的带符号三角数，再从结果中减去「a 的带符号三角数」。

operators.name: ☆₂
operators.definition: a ☆₂ b = { ★₁₃ a, if a < 1 and b >= 10; a @, if a >= 1 and b >= 10; a, else }
operators.plain: If a < 1 and b ≥ 10, apply ★₁₃ to a; otherwise if a ≥ 1 and b ≥ 10, reverse the digits of a; otherwise return a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a < 1 且 b ≥ 10，对 a 应用 ★₁₃；否则若 a ≥ 1 且 b ≥ 10，把 a 的数字倒过来写；否则结果为 a。

operators.name: ◇₃
operators.plain: Start with b. Repeat |a % 3| times: apply ♢₉ to the current value.
operators.plain_zh: 从 b 开始，重复 |a % 3| 次：对结果应用 ♢₉。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order and negation

operators.name: ★₄
operators.plain: Apply ▽₈ to a, then add a to it.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 应用 ▽₈，再把结果加上 a。

operators.name: ●₅
operators.plain: Sum the digits of b, then add the digit sum of a to it.
operators.plain_zh: 先求 b 的各位数字之和，再把结果加上「a 的数字和」。

operators.name: ○₆
operators.plain: Count the one bits of a, then divide it by a, rounding toward zero.
operators.plain_zh: 先数 a 的二进制里有几个 1，再把结果除以 a 并向零取整。

operators.name: ♡₇
operators.plain: Count the one bits of 8, then take the remainder when dividing it by a with its digits reversed.
operators.plain_zh: 先数 8 的二进制里有几个 1，再求结果除以「a 的数字倒写」的余数。

operators.name: ▽₈
operators.plain: Apply ♡₇ to a, then multiply it by the number of one bits in a.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 应用 ♡₇，再把结果乘以「a 的二进制中 1 的个数」。

operators.name: ♢₉
operators.plain: Apply ○₆ to a, then subtract a ♡₇ from it.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 应用 ○₆，再从结果中减去 a ♡₇。

operators.name: ▲₁₀
operators.plain: Apply ●₅ to a and (★₄ a).
operators.plain_zh: 对 a 和 ★₄ a 应用 ●₅。

operators.name: ▽₁₁
operators.plain: Apply ★₄ to b, then add the signed triangle number of a to it.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 b 应用 ★₄，再把结果加上「a 的带符号三角数」。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order and negation

operators.name: ■₁₂
operators.plain: Apply ♢₉ to a, then apply ♦₁ to the result and (-a).
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 应用 ♢₉，再对结果和 -a 应用 ♦₁。

operators.name: ★₁₃
operators.plain: Divide 2 by a, rounding toward zero.
operators.plain_zh: 把 2 除以 a 并向零取整。

operators.name: ♠₁₄
operators.plain: Apply ♢₉ to a, then divide it by the digit sum of a, rounding toward zero.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 应用 ♢₉，再把结果除以「a 的数字和」并向零取整。

operators.name: □₁₅
operators.plain: Apply ♦₁ to 5 and (a ■₁₂).
operators.plain_zh: 对 5 和 a ■₁₂ 应用 ♦₁。

operators.name: □₁₆
operators.plain: Compute a ♦₁ 7.
operators.plain_zh: 对 a 和 7 应用 ♦₁。

operators.name: ☆₁₇
operators.plain: Apply ★₄ to a, then divide it by the signed triangle number of b, rounding toward zero.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 应用 ★₄，再把结果除以「b 的带符号三角数」并向零取整。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order and negation

operators.name: ■₁₈
operators.plain: Compute a ♦₁ 9.
operators.plain_zh: 对 a 和 9 应用 ♦₁。

operators.name: ○₁₉
operators.definition: a ○₁₉ b = { 3 ♦₁ (★₄ a), if a >= 9 and b >= 4 and b < 11; ■₁₈ (b ●₅ a), else }
operators.plain: If a ≥ 9 and b ≥ 4 and b < 11, apply ♦₁ to 3 and (★₄ a); otherwise apply ●₅ to b and a, then apply ■₁₈ to the result.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a ≥ 9 且 b ≥ 4 且 b < 11，对 3 和 ★₄ a 应用 ♦₁；否则先对 b 和 a 应用 ●₅，再对结果应用 ■₁₈。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order

operators.name: ■₂₀
operators.definition: a ■₂₀ = { a - a, if a >= 9; 4 ○₁₉ a, else }
operators.plain: If a ≥ 9, subtract a from a; otherwise compute 4 ○₁₉ a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a ≥ 9，从 a 中减去 a；否则对 4 和 a 应用 ○₁₉。

operators.name: ●₂₁
operators.definition: a ●₂₁ = { a ○₁₉ a, if a >= 6 and a < 8; a % a, if a < 1; a ♦₁ a, else }
operators.plain: If 6 ≤ a < 8, compute a ○₁₉ a; otherwise if a < 1, take the remainder when dividing a by a; otherwise compute a ♦₁ a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 6 ≤ a < 8，把 a 同时作为两个输入应用 ○₁₉；否则若 a < 1，求 a 除以 a 的余数；否则把 a 同时作为两个输入应用 ♦₁。

operators.name: ♠₂₂
operators.definition: a ♠₂₂ b = { ♢₉ b, if a < 0 and b < 1; (3 ●₂₁) ▽₁₁ (a ▲₁₀), else }
operators.plain: If a < 0 and b < 1, apply ♢₉ to b; otherwise apply ●₂₁ to 3, then apply ▽₁₁ to the result and (a ▲₁₀).
operators.plain_zh: 若 a < 0 且 b < 1，对 b 应用 ♢₉；否则先对 3 应用 ●₂₁，再对结果和 a ▲₁₀ 应用 ▽₁₁。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order

operators.name: □₂₃
operators.definition: □₂₃ a = { (- a) ○₁₉ a, if a < 6; (- 1) ♠₂₂ (# a), else }
operators.plain: If a < 6, negate a, then apply ○₁₉ to the result and a; otherwise apply ♠₂₂ to -1 and (the signed triangle number of a).
operators.plain_zh: 若 a < 6，先把 a 取相反数，再对结果和 a 应用 ○₁₉；否则对 -1 和「a 的带符号三角数」应用 ♠₂₂。

operators.name: ◇₂₄
operators.definition: a ◇₂₄ = { (♢₉ a) / (□₂₃ a), if a >= 11; (- a) ☆₂ (□₂₃ a), else }
operators.plain: If a ≥ 11, apply ♢₉ to a, then divide it by □₂₃ a, rounding toward zero; otherwise negate a, then apply ☆₂ to the result and (□₂₃ a).
operators.plain_zh: 若 a ≥ 11，先对 a 应用 ♢₉，再把结果除以 □₂₃ a 并向零取整；否则先把 a 取相反数，再对结果和 □₂₃ a 应用 ☆₂。

operators.name: ☆₂₅
operators.definition: a ☆₂₅ b = { b ●₅ a, if a >= 3 and b < 4; b % b, else }
operators.plain: If a ≥ 3 and b < 4, compute b ●₅ a; otherwise take the remainder when dividing b by b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a ≥ 3 且 b < 4，对 b 和 a 应用 ●₅；否则求 b 除以 b 的余数。

operators.name: ♢₂₆
operators.definition: a ♢₂₆ = { ♢₉ a, if a >= 3 and a < 4; 5 - 0, if a >= 1 and a < 3; a ▽₁₁ a, else }
operators.plain: If 3 ≤ a < 4, apply ♢₉ to a; otherwise if 1 ≤ a < 3, subtract 0 from 5; otherwise compute a ▽₁₁ a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 3 ≤ a < 4，对 a 应用 ♢₉；否则若 1 ≤ a < 3，从 5 中减去 0；否则把 a 同时作为两个输入应用 ▽₁₁。

operators.name: ♦₂₇
operators.definition: a ♦₂₇ = { 2 ♢₂₆, if a < 1; a ●₅ a, else }
operators.plain: If a < 1, apply ♢₂₆ to 2; otherwise compute a ●₅ a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a < 1，对 2 应用 ♢₂₆；否则把 a 同时作为两个输入应用 ●₅。

operators.name: △₂₈
operators.definition: a △₂₈ b = { a ▽₁₁ 4, if a >= 5 and a < 8 and b >= 11; a ▲₁₀, if a < 0 and b >= 2 and b < 11; b ●₅ a, else }
operators.plain: If 5 ≤ a < 8 and b ≥ 11, compute a ▽₁₁ 4; otherwise if a < 0 and b ≥ 2 and b < 11, apply ▲₁₀ to a; otherwise compute b ●₅ a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 5 ≤ a < 8 且 b ≥ 11，对 a 和 4 应用 ▽₁₁；否则若 a < 0 且 b ≥ 2 且 b < 11，对 a 应用 ▲₁₀；否则对 b 和 a 应用 ●₅。

operators.name: ♤₂₉
operators.definition: a ♤₂₉ b = { (□₂₃ a) * (# b), if a >= 5 and a < 9 and b >= 7; (★₄ a) ☆₂₅ (a ♡₇), if a >= 9 and b >= 7; (★₄ b) % a, else }
operators.plain: Chooses between 3 cases by testing a and b; the cases combine □₂₃, ★₄, ☆₂₅, ♡₇, #, % and *.
operators.plain_zh: 按 a、b 的取值在 3 种情形中选一种；各情形组合使用 □₂₃、★₄、☆₂₅、♡₇、#、%、*。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order and negation

operators.name: ♦₃₀
operators.plain: Apply ☆₁₇ to a and (a with its digits reversed).
operators.plain_zh: 对 a 和「a 的数字倒写」应用 ☆₁₇。

operators.name: ◆₃₁
operators.plain: Apply ●₅ to a and a, then apply □₂₃ to the result.
operators.plain_zh: 先把 a 同时作为两个输入应用 ●₅，再对结果应用 □₂₃。

operators.name: ○₃₂
operators.plain: Apply ☆₂ to a and (■₁₈ b).
operators.plain_zh: 对 a 和 ■₁₈ b 应用 ☆₂。

operators.name: △₃₃
operators.definition: a △₃₃ = { a ♦₁ (★₄ a), if a >= 10; (a ♢₂₆) ☆₁₇ a, if a < 0; a - (★₁₃ a), else }
operators.plain: If a ≥ 10, apply ♦₁ to a and (★₄ a); otherwise if a < 0, apply ♢₂₆ to a, then apply ☆₁₇ to the result and a; otherwise subtract ★₁₃ a from a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a ≥ 10，对 a 和 ★₄ a 应用 ♦₁；否则若 a < 0，先对 a 应用 ♢₂₆，再对结果和 a 应用 ☆₁₇；否则从 a 中减去 ★₁₃ a。

operators.name: ▽₃₄
operators.definition: a ▽₃₄ b = { a * b, if a < 4 and b >= 1 and b < 2; (□₂₃ a) + (■₁₈ a), else }
operators.plain: If a < 4 and b ≥ 1 and b < 2, multiply a by b; otherwise apply □₂₃ to a, then add ■₁₈ a to it.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a < 4 且 b ≥ 1 且 b < 2，把 a 乘以 b；否则先对 a 应用 □₂₃，再把结果加上 ■₁₈ a。

operators.name: ♢₃₅
operators.definition: ♢₃₅ a = { (4 □₁₅) - a, if a >= 9; (★₁₃ 1) - a, if a >= 7 and a < 9; ◆₃₁ (a ♤₂₉ a), else }
operators.plain: If a ≥ 9, apply □₁₅ to 4, then subtract a from it; otherwise if 7 ≤ a < 9, apply ★₁₃ to 1, then subtract a from it; otherwise apply ♤₂₉ to a and a, then apply ◆₃₁ to the result.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a ≥ 9，先对 4 应用 □₁₅，再从结果中减去 a；否则若 7 ≤ a < 9，先对 1 应用 ★₁₃，再从结果中减去 a；否则先把 a 同时作为两个输入应用 ♤₂₉，再对结果应用 ◆₃₁。

operators.name: △₃₆
operators.plain: Apply □₂₃ to b, then divide it by ♢₉ a, rounding toward zero.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 b 应用 □₂₃，再把结果除以 ♢₉ a 并向零取整。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order and negation

operators.name: ●₃₇
operators.plain: Compute a ●₅ 2.
operators.plain_zh: 对 a 和 2 应用 ●₅。

operators.name: □₃₈
operators.plain: Negate a, then apply △₂₈ to the result and (□₁₆ 2).
operators.plain_zh: 先把 a 取相反数，再对结果和 □₁₆ 2 应用 △₂₈。

operators.name: ○₃₉
operators.plain: Sum the digits of a, then apply ○₁₉ to the result and a.
operators.plain_zh: 先求 a 的各位数字之和，再对结果和 a 应用 ○₁₉。

operators.name: ♤₄₀
operators.definition: a ♤₄₀ b = { (□₁₆ b) △₃₃, if a >= 3 and b >= 3 and b < 6; (◆₃₁ a) ○₁₉ (★₄ a), else }
operators.plain: If a ≥ 3 and b ≥ 3 and b < 6, apply □₁₆ to b, then apply △₃₃ to the result; otherwise apply ◆₃₁ to a, then apply ○₁₉ to the result and (★₄ a).
operators.plain_zh: 若 a ≥ 3 且 b ≥ 3 且 b < 6，先对 b 应用 □₁₆，再对结果应用 △₃₃；否则先对 a 应用 ◆₃₁，再对结果和 ★₄ a 应用 ○₁₉。

operators.name: △₄₁
operators.plain: Add a to 1.
operators.plain_zh: 把 1 加上 a。

operators.name: ♧₄₂
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b % 8| times: apply ☆₁₇ to the current value and the current value.
operators.plain_zh: 从 a 开始，重复 |b % 8| 次：把结果同时作为两个输入应用 ☆₁₇。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order and negation

operators.name: ○₄₃
operators.plain: Start with b. Repeat |a % 5| times: apply □₂₃ to the current value.
operators.plain_zh: 从 b 开始，重复 |a % 5| 次：对结果应用 □₂₃。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order

operators.name: ▲₄₄
operators.plain: Recurse on b, counting with b % 3: when b % 3 = 0 the result is 11; otherwise let r be the result for (b % 3) - 1 (or (b % 3) + 1 when b % 3 < 0), then apply ▽₃₄ to r and b.
operators.plain_zh: 对 b 递归，用 b % 3 计数：b % 3 = 0 时结果为 11；否则先求 (b % 3) - 1（b % 3 < 0 时用 (b % 3) + 1）的结果 r，再对 r 和 b 应用 ▽₃₄。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order

operators.name: △₄₅
operators.plain: Recurse on a, counting with a % 6: when a % 6 = 0 the result is a; otherwise let r be the result for (a % 6) - 1 (or (a % 6) + 1 when a % 6 < 0), then apply ♦₂₇ to r.
operators.plain_zh: 对 a 递归，用 a % 6 计数：a % 6 = 0 时结果为 a；否则先求 (a % 6) - 1（a % 6 < 0 时用 (a % 6) + 1）的结果 r，再对 r 应用 ♦₂₇。

operators.name: △₄₆
operators.plain: Start with 4. Repeat |b % 5| times: apply ■₁₂ to the current value.
operators.plain_zh: 从 4 开始，重复 |b % 5| 次：对结果应用 ■₁₂。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order and negation

operators.name: ♠₄₇
operators.plain: Start with 7. Repeat |a % 6| times: apply ♢₂₆ to the current value.
operators.plain_zh: 从 7 开始，重复 |a % 6| 次：对结果应用 ♢₂₆。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order and negation

operators.name: ○₄₈
operators.plain: Start with 4. Repeat |a % 6| times: apply ○₃₉ to the current value.
operators.plain_zh: 从 4 开始，重复 |a % 6| 次：对结果应用 ○₃₉。

operators.name: ♢₄₉
operators.plain: Recurse on a, counting with a % 4: when a % 4 = 0 the result is a; otherwise let r be the result for (a % 4) - 1 (or (a % 4) + 1 when a % 4 < 0), then replace r by a ○₃₂ r.
operators.plain_zh: 对 a 递归，用 a % 4 计数：a % 4 = 0 时结果为 a；否则先求 (a % 4) - 1（a % 4 < 0 时用 (a % 4) + 1）的结果 r，再把 r 换成 a ○₃₂ r。

operators.name: △₅₀
operators.plain: Recurse on a, counting with a % 5: when a % 5 = 0 the result is 10; otherwise let r be the result for (a % 5) - 1 (or (a % 5) + 1 when a % 5 < 0), then replace r by a ●₅ r.
operators.plain_zh: 对 a 递归，用 a % 5 计数：a % 5 = 0 时结果为 10；否则先求 (a % 5) - 1（a % 5 < 0 时用 (a % 5) + 1）的结果 r，再把 r 换成 a ●₅ r。

operators.name: ☆₅₁
operators.plain: Compute a ▲₄₄ a.
operators.plain_zh: 把 a 同时作为两个输入应用 ▲₄₄。

operators.name: □₅₂
operators.plain: Compute a ○₄₃ a.
operators.plain_zh: 把 a 同时作为两个输入应用 ○₄₃。

operators.name: △₅₃
operators.plain: Apply ♢₄₉ to a, then apply ◇₃ to the result and a.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 应用 ♢₄₉，再对结果和 a 应用 ◇₃。

operators.name: ☆₅₄
operators.plain: Apply ♢₄₉ to a, then apply △₄₆ to the result and (a □₃₈).
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 应用 ♢₄₉，再对结果和 a □₃₈ 应用 △₄₆。

operators.name: ◆₅₅
operators.plain: Apply △₅₀ to a, then apply ▽₃₄ to the result and (itself).
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 应用 △₅₀，再把结果同时作为两个输入应用 ▽₃₄。

operators.name: ☆₅₆
operators.plain: Subtract □₅₂ a from a.
operators.plain_zh: 从 a 中减去 □₅₂ a。

operators.name: ★₅₇
operators.plain: Compute a ♧₄₂ a.
operators.plain_zh: 把 a 同时作为两个输入应用 ♧₄₂。

operators.name: ♡₅₈
operators.plain: Apply ○₄₈ to b, then subtract ♢₄₉ a from it.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 b 应用 ○₄₈，再从结果中减去 ♢₄₉ a。

operators.name: ♠₅₉
operators.plain: Apply △₅₀ to 0, then apply ◇₃ to the result and (△₄₁ a).
operators.plain_zh: 先对 0 应用 △₅₀，再对结果和 △₄₁ a 应用 ◇₃。

operators.name: ◇₆₀
operators.plain: Apply ♡₇ to a, then apply ♠₄₇ to the result and (★₁₃ a).
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 应用 ♡₇，再对结果和 ★₁₃ a 应用 ♠₄₇。

operators.name: ◆₆₁
operators.plain: Compute a ♡₅₈ 0.
operators.plain_zh: 对 a 和 0 应用 ♡₅₈。

operators.name: □₆₂
operators.plain: Compute a ♠₄₇ a.
operators.plain_zh: 把 a 同时作为两个输入应用 ♠₄₇。

operators.name: ♥₆₃
operators.plain: Apply ◇₂₄ to a, then apply ▲₄₄ to the result and (△₅₃ a).
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 应用 ◇₂₄，再对结果和 △₅₃ a 应用 ▲₄₄。

operators.name: ♢₆₄
operators.plain: Apply ●₂₁ to a, then apply ▲₄₄ to the result and (a ◆₅₅).
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 应用 ●₂₁，再对结果和 a ◆₅₅ 应用 ▲₄₄。

operators.name: ♥₆₅
operators.plain: Apply ☆₅₄ to a, then subtract a ■₂₀ from it.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 应用 ☆₅₄，再从结果中减去 a ■₂₀。

operators.name: △₆₆
operators.definition: a △₆₆ b = { a ♧₄₂ a, if a >= 1 and b >= 11; a, else }
operators.plain: If a ≥ 1 and b ≥ 11, compute a ♧₄₂ a; otherwise return a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a ≥ 1 且 b ≥ 11，把 a 同时作为两个输入应用 ♧₄₂；否则结果为 a。

operators.name: △₆₇
operators.definition: a △₆₇ b = { (△₄₅ a) △₃₆ (b ◆₅₅), if a < 9 and b >= 6 and b < 11; b ☆₂₅ a, else }
operators.plain: If a < 9 and b ≥ 6 and b < 11, apply △₄₅ to a, then apply △₃₆ to the result and (b ◆₅₅); otherwise compute b ☆₂₅ a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a < 9 且 b ≥ 6 且 b < 11，先对 a 应用 △₄₅，再对结果和 b ◆₅₅ 应用 △₃₆；否则对 b 和 a 应用 ☆₂₅。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order

operators.name: ♤₆₈
operators.definition: a ♤₆₈ b = { a ○₄₃ a, if a < 7 and b >= 7 and b < 8; ☆₅₄ 2, if a >= 7 and b >= 8 and b < 10; 3 ○₁₉ b, else }
operators.plain: If a < 7 and b ≥ 7 and b < 8, compute a ○₄₃ a; otherwise if a ≥ 7 and b ≥ 8 and b < 10, apply ☆₅₄ to 2; otherwise compute 3 ○₁₉ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a < 7 且 b ≥ 7 且 b < 8，把 a 同时作为两个输入应用 ○₄₃；否则若 a ≥ 7 且 b ≥ 8 且 b < 10，对 2 应用 ☆₅₄；否则对 3 和 b 应用 ○₁₉。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order

operators.name: ♦₆₉
operators.definition: a ♦₆₉ b = { ★₁₃ b, if a >= 8 and a < 10 and b < 0; △₄₅ b, if a >= 0 and a < 8 and b >= 2; b ●₅ b, else }
operators.plain: If 8 ≤ a < 10 and b < 0, apply ★₁₃ to b; otherwise if 0 ≤ a < 8 and b ≥ 2, apply △₄₅ to b; otherwise compute b ●₅ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 8 ≤ a < 10 且 b < 0，对 b 应用 ★₁₃；否则若 0 ≤ a < 8 且 b ≥ 2，对 b 应用 △₄₅；否则把 b 同时作为两个输入应用 ●₅。

operators.name: ★₇₀
operators.definition: a ★₇₀ = { # (a ○₃₂ a), if a >= 7 and a < 8; (♥₆₅ a) ◆₅₅, if a >= 11; - (0 ◆₅₅), else }
operators.plain: If 7 ≤ a < 8, apply ○₃₂ to a and a, then take its signed triangle number; otherwise if a ≥ 11, apply ♥₆₅ to a, then apply ◆₅₅ to the result; otherwise apply ◆₅₅ to 0, then negate it.
operators.plain_zh: 若 7 ≤ a < 8，先把 a 同时作为两个输入应用 ○₃₂，再求结果的带符号三角数；否则若 a ≥ 11，先对 a 应用 ♥₆₅，再对结果应用 ◆₅₅；否则先对 0 应用 ◆₅₅，再把结果取相反数。

operators.name: ♥₇₁
operators.plain: If a ≥ 7, apply ◆₅₅ to a; otherwise apply ■₂₀ to 4.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a ≥ 7，对 a 应用 ◆₅₅；否则对 4 应用 ■₂₀。

operators.name: ♦₇₂
operators.definition: a ♦₇₂ b = { (b ♠₂₂ 11) ☆₅₁, if a < 0 and b >= 4 and b < 7; (a ◆₅₅) ♤₆₈ (b ★₇₀), if a >= 0 and a < 1 and b >= 7; ♠₅₉ (◆₃₁ 0), else }
operators.plain: If a < 0 and b ≥ 4 and b < 7, apply ♠₂₂ to b and 11, then apply ☆₅₁ to the result; otherwise if 0 ≤ a < 1 and b ≥ 7, apply ◆₅₅ to a, then apply ♤₆₈ to the result and (b ★₇₀); otherwise apply ◆₃₁ to 0, then apply ♠₅₉ to the result.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a < 0 且 b ≥ 4 且 b < 7，先对 b 和 11 应用 ♠₂₂，再对结果应用 ☆₅₁；否则若 0 ≤ a < 1 且 b ≥ 7，先对 a 应用 ◆₅₅，再对结果和 b ★₇₀ 应用 ♤₆₈；否则先对 0 应用 ◆₃₁，再对结果应用 ♠₅₉。

operators.name: ♡₇₃
operators.definition: ♡₇₃ a = { 1 ♠₄₇ 2, if a >= 7 and a < 8; a ♥₇₁, if a >= 3 and a < 7; a ♧₄₂ a, else }
operators.plain: If 7 ≤ a < 8, compute 1 ♠₄₇ 2; otherwise if 3 ≤ a < 7, apply ♥₇₁ to a; otherwise compute a ♧₄₂ a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 7 ≤ a < 8，对 1 和 2 应用 ♠₄₇；否则若 3 ≤ a < 7，对 a 应用 ♥₇₁；否则把 a 同时作为两个输入应用 ♧₄₂。

operators.name: ☆₇₄
operators.definition: a ☆₇₄ b = { 3 ☆₂₅ (◇₆₀ b), if a >= 4 and a < 10 and b >= 5; (1 $) △₄₆ (□₅₂ b), else }
operators.plain: If 4 ≤ a < 10 and b ≥ 5, apply ☆₂₅ to 3 and (◇₆₀ b); otherwise count the one bits of 1, then apply △₄₆ to the result and (□₅₂ b).
operators.plain_zh: 若 4 ≤ a < 10 且 b ≥ 5，对 3 和 ◇₆₀ b 应用 ☆₂₅；否则先数 1 的二进制里有几个 1，再对结果和 □₅₂ b 应用 △₄₆。

operators.name: ▼₇₅
operators.definition: a ▼₇₅ b = { (a $) ♤₆₈ (b ■₁₂), if a >= 0 and a < 7 and b >= 3 and b < 8; b ♠₁₄, else }
operators.plain: If 0 ≤ a < 7 and b ≥ 3 and b < 8, count the one bits of a, then apply ♤₆₈ to the result and (b ■₁₂); otherwise apply ♠₁₄ to b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 0 ≤ a < 7 且 b ≥ 3 且 b < 8，先数 a 的二进制里有几个 1，再对结果和 b ■₁₂ 应用 ♤₆₈；否则对 b 应用 ♠₁₄。

operators.name: ♧₇₆
operators.plain: Start with b. Repeat |a % 7| times: apply □₅₂ to the current value.
operators.plain_zh: 从 b 开始，重复 |a % 7| 次：对结果应用 □₅₂。

operators.name: ▼₇₇
operators.plain: Recurse on a, counting with a % 6: when a % 6 = 0 the result is a; otherwise let r be the result for (a % 6) - 1 (or (a % 6) + 1 when a % 6 < 0), then apply ♤₆₈ to r and a.
operators.plain_zh: 对 a 递归，用 a % 6 计数：a % 6 = 0 时结果为 a；否则先求 (a % 6) - 1（a % 6 < 0 时用 (a % 6) + 1）的结果 r，再对 r 和 a 应用 ♤₆₈。

operators.name: ◇₇₈
operators.plain: Recurse on a, counting with a % 8: when a % 8 = 0 the result is a; otherwise let r be the result for (a % 8) - 1 (or (a % 8) + 1 when a % 8 < 0), then apply ♢₆₄ to r.
operators.plain_zh: 对 a 递归，用 a % 8 计数：a % 8 = 0 时结果为 a；否则先求 (a % 8) - 1（a % 8 < 0 时用 (a % 8) + 1）的结果 r，再对 r 应用 ♢₆₄。

operators.name: ☆₇₉
operators.plain: Recurse on b, counting with b % 3: when b % 3 = 0 the result is a; otherwise let r be the result for (b % 3) - 1 (or (b % 3) + 1 when b % 3 < 0), then replace r by b ▲₄₄ r.
operators.plain_zh: 对 b 递归，用 b % 3 计数：b % 3 = 0 时结果为 a；否则先求 (b % 3) - 1（b % 3 < 0 时用 (b % 3) + 1）的结果 r，再把 r 换成 b ▲₄₄ r。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order

operators.name: ★₈₀
operators.plain: Recurse on a, counting with a % 6: when a % 6 = 0 the result is 2; otherwise let r be the result for (a % 6) - 1 (or (a % 6) + 1 when a % 6 < 0), then replace r by a ♠₄₇ r.
operators.plain_zh: 对 a 递归，用 a % 6 计数：a % 6 = 0 时结果为 2；否则先求 (a % 6) - 1（a % 6 < 0 时用 (a % 6) + 1）的结果 r，再把 r 换成 a ♠₄₇ r。

operators.name: ☆₈₁
operators.plain: Recurse on a, counting with a % 7: when a % 7 = 0 the result is a; otherwise let r be the result for (a % 7) - 1 (or (a % 7) + 1 when a % 7 < 0), then apply ☆₅₄ to r.
operators.plain_zh: 对 a 递归，用 a % 7 计数：a % 7 = 0 时结果为 a；否则先求 (a % 7) - 1（a % 7 < 0 时用 (a % 7) + 1）的结果 r，再对 r 应用 ☆₅₄。

operators.name: ▲₈₂
operators.plain: Start with 6. Repeat |a % 5| times: apply ♥₇₁ to the current value.
operators.plain_zh: 从 6 开始，重复 |a % 5| 次：对结果应用 ♥₇₁。

operators.name: ♢₈₃
operators.plain: Divide 7 by a ▼₇₇, rounding toward zero.
operators.plain_zh: 把 7 除以 a ▼₇₇ 并向零取整。

operators.name: ♥₈₄
operators.plain: Apply ☆₈₁ to a, then apply △₆₇ to the result and (a ◇₇₈).
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 应用 ☆₈₁，再对结果和 a ◇₇₈ 应用 △₆₇。

operators.name: ●₈₅
operators.plain: Compute a ☆₇₉ a.
operators.plain_zh: 把 a 同时作为两个输入应用 ☆₇₉。

operators.name: ♤₈₆
operators.plain: Compute a ♧₇₆ a.
operators.plain_zh: 把 a 同时作为两个输入应用 ♧₇₆。

operators.name: ♤₈₇
operators.plain: Apply ☆₅₆ to a, then subtract a ▼₇₇ from it.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 应用 ☆₅₆，再从结果中减去 a ▼₇₇。

operators.name: ♥₈₈
operators.plain: Apply □₂₃ to 0, then apply ♧₇₆ to the result and (★₈₀ a).
operators.plain_zh: 先对 0 应用 □₂₃，再对结果和 ★₈₀ a 应用 ♧₇₆。

operators.name: ▽₈₉
operators.plain: Apply ♤₈₆ to a, then apply ●₅ to the result and (●₈₅ a).
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 应用 ♤₈₆，再对结果和 ●₈₅ a 应用 ●₅。

operators.name: ★₉₀
operators.plain: Apply ♤₈₇ to a, then apply ♠₄₇ to the result and (◇₆₀ a).
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 应用 ♤₈₇，再对结果和 ◇₆₀ a 应用 ♠₄₇。

operators.name: ▲₉₁
operators.plain: Compute 3 ♧₇₆ a.
operators.plain_zh: 对 3 和 a 应用 ♧₇₆。

operators.name: ■₉₂
operators.plain: Apply ▽₈₉ to a, then apply △₄₆ to the result and (★₄ a).
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 应用 ▽₈₉，再对结果和 ★₄ a 应用 △₄₆。

operators.name: ▼₉₃
operators.plain: Compute a ▲₈₂ a.
operators.plain_zh: 把 a 同时作为两个输入应用 ▲₈₂。

operators.name: ■₉₄
operators.definition: a ■₉₄ b = { 4 ♠₂₂ b, if a >= 7 and b < 8; a ○₄₃ 1, if a >= 7 and b >= 11; ★₈₀ b, else }
operators.plain: If a ≥ 7 and b < 8, compute 4 ♠₂₂ b; otherwise if a ≥ 7 and b ≥ 11, compute a ○₄₃ 1; otherwise apply ★₈₀ to b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a ≥ 7 且 b < 8，对 4 和 b 应用 ♠₂₂；否则若 a ≥ 7 且 b ≥ 11，对 a 和 1 应用 ○₄₃；否则对 b 应用 ★₈₀。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order

operators.name: ●₉₅
operators.definition: a ●₉₅ b = { a, if a >= 1 and a < 5 and b < 7; a ■₉₄ (○₃₉ a), else }
operators.plain: If 1 ≤ a < 5 and b < 7, return a; otherwise apply ■₉₄ to a and (○₃₉ a).
operators.plain_zh: 若 1 ≤ a < 5 且 b < 7，结果为 a；否则对 a 和 ○₃₉ a 应用 ■₉₄。

operators.name: ♥₉₆
operators.definition: a ♥₉₆ b = { (b ♤₈₇) ◇₃ (●₈₅ b), if a < 3 and b < 5; a ▲₄₄ (a ■₂₀), else }
operators.plain: If a < 3 and b < 5, apply ♤₈₇ to b, then apply ◇₃ to the result and (●₈₅ b); otherwise apply ▲₄₄ to a and (a ■₂₀).
operators.plain_zh: 若 a < 3 且 b < 5，先对 b 应用 ♤₈₇，再对结果和 ●₈₅ b 应用 ◇₃；否则对 a 和 a ■₂₀ 应用 ▲₄₄。

operators.name: ■₉₇
operators.definition: a ■₉₇ = { ★₉₀ a, if a >= 9; ☆₈₁ a, if a >= 1 and a < 7; a △₆₆ a, else }
operators.plain: If a ≥ 9, apply ★₉₀ to a; otherwise if 1 ≤ a < 7, apply ☆₈₁ to a; otherwise compute a △₆₆ a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a ≥ 9，对 a 应用 ★₉₀；否则若 1 ≤ a < 7，对 a 应用 ☆₈₁；否则把 a 同时作为两个输入应用 △₆₆。

operators.name: △₉₈
operators.definition: △₉₈ a = { a ■₉₄ a, if a >= 2 and a < 3; ◆₆₁ a, if a < 2; a, else }
operators.plain: If 2 ≤ a < 3, compute a ■₉₄ a; otherwise if a < 2, apply ◆₆₁ to a; otherwise return a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 2 ≤ a < 3，把 a 同时作为两个输入应用 ■₉₄；否则若 a < 2，对 a 应用 ◆₆₁；否则结果为 a。

operators.name: ♡₉₉
operators.definition: a ♡₉₉ = { ★₉₀ a, if a < 1; a ▲₈₂ a, else }
operators.plain: If a < 1, apply ★₉₀ to a; otherwise compute a ▲₈₂ a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a < 1，对 a 应用 ★₉₀；否则把 a 同时作为两个输入应用 ▲₈₂。

operators.name: ♧₁₀₀
operators.definition: a ♧₁₀₀ b = { (a ♤₈₇) ♡₅₈ a, if a >= 7 and b < 3; (a ▲₉₁) % b, else }
operators.plain: If a ≥ 7 and b < 3, apply ♤₈₇ to a, then apply ♡₅₈ to the result and a; otherwise apply ▲₉₁ to a, then take the remainder when dividing it by b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a ≥ 7 且 b < 3，先对 a 应用 ♤₈₇，再对结果和 a 应用 ♡₅₈；否则先对 a 应用 ▲₉₁，再求结果除以 b 的余数。
